extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / new editors attempting to create an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or locating a Wikipedia article for a specific title (how to proceed if an article with that exact name is missing). Includes procedural requirements (account/autoconfirmation), discovery steps, and troubleshooting tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is presented as a prerequisite step for creating new Wikipedia pages; without an autoconfirmed account you cannot create the article directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed) or prefer review, submit a draft via the article wizard or use the 'request a new article' process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Holy Shit Were Heroes' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages linking to the target title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding inbound links can reveal mentions or redirects and help determine whether the topic is already covered elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delay in database updates / purge troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect an existing page but cannot see it, wait briefly or use the purge function to refresh; the absence might be a temporary visibility/update issue rather than a true missing page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify different capitalizations of the title and, when appropriate, create redirects so users find the canonical article regardless of capitalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if a page was removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a previously created article is missing, consult the deletion log and the linked guidance to understand deletion reasons before attempting recreation.
